sections.title: Acceptance
sections.content: All three EW prototypes were inferior to the Select control on all acceptance measures: % 70+ mean thermometer Top 2 box Purchase Interest There were no significant differences across the prototypes themselves.

content.description: Although both the CT/21mm filter and CAMEL blend/21mm were both parity to Select, CAMEL was closest to the ideal. The 21mm prototype was inferior to all other products due to its lack of strength.
CT/21mm was parity with Select while Camel and CT/21 were inferior – did not have enough tobacco taste.
Cam burned parity w select while CT protos burned too quickly.
